label: Commercial landlord — retail food tenant
summary: A food tenant carries cooking, slip and liquor exposure. These numbers are our inference from the baseline, not a sourced requirement.
unverified_note: Our suggestion — not from a published source. Lease insurance clauses are negotiated per lease and no standard form exists for food tenants. Paste your own lease clause instead of relying on this.

requirements.note: Statutory workers' compensation where the tenant has employees.
Required only where the tenant serves alcohol. Tracked as advisory so it appears in the report without marking a tenant red who does not serve.
